sloka: मम अपि प्रतिगृह्णीष्व शरान् चाप गुण च्युतान् ।एवम् उक्त्वा सुसंरब्धः शरान् आशीविष उपमान् ॥३-२७-१३॥
transliteration: mama api pratigṛhṇīṣva śarān cāpa guṇa cyutān ।evam uktvā susaṁrabdhaḥ śarān āśīviṣa upamān ॥3-27-13॥

translations.english: Receive the arrows released from my bowstring. Saying so, the angry and agitated Rama discharged fourteen arrows, venomous like a snake, on the chest of Trisira .
